generator.params.bud_area.note: The leaf area its `bud` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows: the bud is now its flower closed, where before it drew the fruit ovoid.

generator.params.leaf_area.note: The area its `leaf` look draws on an organ 1 m long (visual forms Skill 5, 2026-10-15; plantc atlas), so it shades with what it shows: its stem leaves now take the monocots' strap rule and draw a linear blade, where before they drew a simple card (0.051).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 1 (1923), as Sisyrinchium idahoense: stems 10 cm to 45 cm tall. The typical value is the one the plant was drawn at before, inside the source's range.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small iris relative with tufts of flat, grass-like leaves and starry blue-violet flowers with yellow eyes. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.3 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green leaves; blue-violet flowers. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): six blue-violet tepals in two whorls on an inferior ovary, three stamens and a pistil of three carpels, from the characters of Iridaceae by the rules at the flowering plants.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

generator.params.basal_area.note: The leaf area its `basal` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows, now that the look follows the species' stated facts (was 0.030).

generator.params.basal_piece_area.note: The leaf area its `basal_piece` look draws on an organ 1 m long (plantc's shading-area test), so it shades with what it shows, now that the look follows the species' stated facts (was 0.055).
